class.name: DSProfilerResult
class.brief_description: Stores detailed timing, throughput, and error metrics for a DirectStorage I/O batch execution or workload.
class.description: [DSProfilerResult] encapsulates performance and execution telemetry recorded during DirectStorage and fallback batch processing. It reports physical storage read durations, CPU/GPU decompression timing, byte counts, and calculated logical and physical throughput in decimal (MB/s) and binary (MiB/s) units. Instances are created by [DSProfiler] and retrieved via [method DSProfiler.get_last_result] or [method DSProfiler.get_result_history].

method.name: get_compressed_bytes_read
method.description: Returns the total number of physical/compressed bytes read from storage during the workload.

method.name: get_decompression_duration_usec
method.description: Returns the decompression duration in microseconds, or [code]-1[/code] if decompression was integrated with GPU completion or not separately measurable.

method.name: get_end_time_usec
method.description: Returns the monotonic end timestamp of the batch in microseconds, or [code]0[/code] when the caller did not supply timestamps.

method.name: get_error_state
method.description: Returns the error status code recorded during the workload ([code]0[/code] for success, non-zero on error).

method.name: get_logical_throughput_mbps
method.description: Returns the logical decompression throughput in decimal megabytes per second (MB/s).

method.name: get_logical_throughput_mibps
method.description: Returns the logical decompression throughput in mebibytes per second (MiB/s).

method.name: get_physical_read_duration_usec
method.description: Returns the physical storage I/O read duration in microseconds.

method.name: get_physical_throughput_mbps
method.description: Returns the physical storage read throughput in decimal megabytes per second (MB/s).

method.name: get_physical_throughput_mibps
method.description: Returns the physical storage read throughput in mebibytes per second (MiB/s).

method.name: get_request_count
method.description: Returns the number of read requests included in the profiled workload.

method.name: get_start_time_usec
method.description: Returns the monotonic start timestamp of the batch in microseconds, or [code]0[/code] when the caller did not supply timestamps.

method.name: get_uncompressed_bytes_produced
method.description: Returns the total number of uncompressed (logical) bytes produced after decompression.
